text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
WHEAT SALE - South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd said Wednesday it bought 22,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Mitsubishi Corp. Shipment was set for February 1-28.

- Moroccan private traders purchased 40,000 tonnes of Argentine soft wheat at $155 to $158 per tonne C&F for December delivery. A first lot of 20,000 tonnes of soft wheat was acquired at $158 per tonne C&F for arrival in the first half of December. The second lot of 20,000 tonnes was bought at $155 per tonne C&F for Dec 15-30 delivery.
SOYOIL SALE - China recently purchased at least 20,000 tonnes of U.S. soyoil for shipment from the U.S. Gulf in the next seven days, export sources said.

RICE SALE - Costa Rica on Tuesday bought 46,000 tonnes U.S. long-grain paddy rice in two parcels. One lot was for 23,000 tonnes at $288.34 a tonne CIF for February arrival, and the other for 23,000 tonnes at seller's option.

"They also bought 23,000 tonnes of U.S. long-grain rice at $291.41 a tonne CIF for April arrival or, at seller's option, Argentinian long-grain paddy at $286.41 a tonne CIF for April arrival," a U.S. exporter said.

CORN AND SOY SALE - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp on Wednesday bought a combined shipment of 18,000 tonnes of No.2 or better U.S. yellow corn and 12,000 tonnes of No.2 or better U.S. yellow soybeans from Mitsui, traders said.

The maximum moisture limits for the shipment are specified as 14.5 percent for the corn and 13.5 percent for the soybeans. The tender specifies shipment from the U.S. Gulf or Pacific Northwest and the grain was bought on a FOB basis with freight fixed at US$18.60 a tonne.

WHEAT BRAN TENDER - South Korea's Korea Feed Association has invited tenders for 12,000 tonnes of wheat bran pellet by 11.30 a.m. (0230 GMT) on Thursday. Traders said shipment was set for January 1-20 if sourced from China or for November 21-December 10 if from South America. Arrival was slated for January 20 to the cities of Inchon and Ulsan.

WHEAT TENDER - Morocco on Friday will launch a tender to buy 10,000 tonnes optional soft wheat for December delivery, an official at the state-owned Office Interprofessionnel des Cereales et Legumineuses said on Wednesday. He said it would be delivered on December 1-10 at the port of Nador.
- The CCC was tendering on November 20 for up to 16,910 tonnes of U.S. number two hard red winter wheat for export to Mozambique. Shipment was slated for Dec 5-31.

- The CCC said it was tendering on November 20 for up to 16,100 tonnes of U.S. wheat for export to Iraq. Shipment was slated for December 5-30. It sought number two or better wheat, excluding unclassed, mixed and durum wheat.

COTTONSEED AND RAPESEED MEAL TENDERS - South Korea's National Livestock Co-operatives Federation said Wednesday it would invite tenders for 15,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal and 15,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal by 11.00 a.m. (0200 GMT) for February shipment.
